name: Holzwickede (Germany)
description: Horizontally divided red over white, charged at the centre with the municipal arms of Holzwickede (a green tree on yellow above a red and white chequy base).
history: The arms were most recently granted on 7 October 1971 together with the seal, the flag and the banner by the Regierungspräsident in Arnsberg; the banner is parted red and white with the arms above the centre.
